patthana8.12:1.1: na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokiyo ca na lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.12:2.1: na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.12:3.1: na lokiyañca na lokuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.12:4.1: hetuyā pañca ārammaṇe dve avigate pañca sabbattha vitthāro. na kenaciviññeyyadukaṃ
